meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
For acne-prone skin in India under ₹700, the best choice depends on whether you want to treat **active breakouts/clogged pores** (using Salicylic Acid) or **fade post-acne marks and control oil** (using Niacinamide).

Top options available within your budget include:

The Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum **unclogs pores and fights blackheads** effectively. It provides **gentle exfoliation** to prevent future breakouts.

The The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% targets blemishes, **controls excess oil**, and **minimizes enlarged pores** with a lightweight formula.

The Chemist at Play 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum combines salicylic acid with **zinc PCA and soothing green tea extract** to calm redness and **reduce excess sebum**.

The Plum 10% Niacinamide Face Serum with Rice Water helps **fade stubborn acne marks** while **boosting skin barrier health** and hydration.
